caption: The video captures a night-time outdoor light show projected onto a modern building with a central cylindrical tower flanked by two flat rectangular wings. Its facade is floodlit in saturated color while a silhouetted crowd stands in the foreground and one figure at the right edge holds up a camera. Bright green laser beams pour from a glowing point at the base-center, spreading outward in a dense radial fan. This fan collapses into near darkness, then narrow diagonal and vertical beams reappear. The beams then shift into side-only fans while the floodlight turns from blue to magenta. A dense radial fan returns around the magenta tower before the color drifts back toward blue. The fan fades to darkness again, leaving only the lit building and a few faint top beams. A vertical center beam and crossing diagonals emerge, then vanish into another dark interval. Side-only beams appear again, the crowd and that figure remaining unmoved.
